_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator and franchisor of 3,420 properties (595,461 rooms)'; 'Our industries are highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts, and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national, and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'Weak economic conditions in the United States, Europe and much of the rest of the world, instability in the financial markets following the worldwide financial crisis that began in 2008, and weak consumer confidence all contributed to a difficult business environment in 2009' (its own FY2009 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator and franchisor of 3,420 properties (595,461 rooms)'; 'Our industries are highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts, and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national, and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'Weak economic conditions in the United States, Europe and much of the rest of the world, instability in the financial markets following the worldwide financial crisis that began in 2008, and weak consumer confidence all contributed to a difficult business environment in 2009' (its own FY2009 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 8.80x; +83% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.85; conservative 2yr -11%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY00-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.4%/yr (Q2 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.4%/yr (FY00-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +31.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2010-05-21) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 8.80x (81.8% downside to Bear $6 / +9.3% upside to Bull $36) | Adj composite 2.44 vs market 3.29: gap -0.85 [OVERVALUED] | +83% above the EPP floor $18 (18x FY10E $1.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.8% total (-5.4%/yr) | At 32.9x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $44 sits above the BULL case; North American RevPAR -1.9% in Q1 2010, forward fee revenue +8.27-12.2% (Q2 2010 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
